summary: A simple personal library loan tracker to record books, lend them to someone, mark them returned, and filter to only lent-out items. Data persists locally in the browser.
implemented_features: Add books with title, author, and kind (Novel/Cookbook/Reference/Other)
List all books with current loan status (Available vs Lent to <name>)
Lend out an available book by entering borrower name
Mark a lent book as returned (clears borrower)
Filter list to show only books currently lent out
Derived summary counts: total books and number lent out
LocalStorage persistence across page refresh with malformed-data recovery
assumptions: Book kinds are a small fixed set (Novel, Cookbook, Reference, Other) to match the examples and keep entry consistent.
No due dates/history are tracked; returning a book simply clears the borrower name.
Single-user, local-only usage: persistence uses browser localStorage and the app remains usable even if storage fails (in-memory only).

tests_run.journey: Add a book, lend it out, filter to lent-out, verify persistence via remount, mark returned, edit, and delete
Validation: prevent lending without entering a borrower name
